pairs: The Lord also said to Moses:
Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron,
and you shall say to them:
Ne contaminetur sacerdos in mortibus civium suorum,
Do not allow a priest to be contaminated by the death of his citizens,
nisi tantum in consanguineis, ac propinquis,
except only by his blood-relatives and near-relatives,
or by a son or daughter,
et sorore virgine quæ non est nupta viro:
or a virgin sister, who is not married to a husband.
sed nec in principe populi sui contaminabitur.
But not even by the leader of his people shall he be contaminated.
Neither shall they shave their head
neque in carnibus suis facient incisuras.
and they shall not make incisions in their flesh.
They shall be holy to their God,
and they shall not pollute his name.
For they offer the incense of the Lord
and the bread of their God,
and because of this they shall be holy.
They shall not take as a wife a promiscuous woman,
et vile prostibulum non ducent uxorem,
nec eam quæ repudiata est a marito:
or her who has been repudiated by her husband.
For they are consecrated to their God,
et panes propositionis offerunt. Sint ergo sancti,
and they offer the bread of the presence. Therefore,
let them be holy, for I also am holy:
Sacerdotis filia si deprehensa fuerit in stupro,
If the daughter of a priest will have been taken into prostitution,
and will have violated the name of her father,
she shall be consumed by fire.
the priest who is the greatest among his brothers,
super cujus caput fusum est unctionis oleum,
upon whose head the oil of anointing has been poured,
et cujus manus in sacerdotio consecratæ sunt,
and whose hands have been consecrated for the priesthood,
and who has been vested with the holy vestments:
he shall not expose his head;
he shall not rend his vestments.
et ad omnem mortuum non ingredietur omnino:
And he shall not enter to any dead body whatsoever;
not even by his father or mother shall he be contaminated.
Neither shall he exit from the holy places,
lest he pollute the Sanctuary of the Lord.
quia oleum sanctæ unctionis Dei sui super eum est.
For the oil of the holy anointing of his God is upon him.
He shall take a virgin as his wife.
or one who has been repudiated or defiled,
but only a maiden from among his own people.
ne commisceat stirpem generis sui vulgo gentis suæ:
He shall not mingle the stock of his family with the common people of his nation.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Homo de semine tuo per familias qui habuerit maculam,
A man from your offspring, throughout their families, who has a blemish,
shall not offer the bread to his God.
Neither shall he approach to minister to him:
if he has a bulging back
or if he has a white spot in his eye,
or a skin disease on his body,
Omnis qui habuerit maculam de semine Aaron sacerdotis,
Anyone from the offspring of Aaron, the priest, who has a blemish,
shall not approach to offer sacrifices to the Lord,
nor the bread to his God.
vescetur tamen panibus qui offeruntur in sanctuario,
Nevertheless, he shall eat from the loaves which are offered in the Sanctuary.
he may not enter within the veil,
et contaminare non debet sanctuarium meum.
and he must not contaminate my Sanctuary.
I am the Lord, who sanctifies them.
Locutus est ergo Moyses ad Aaron,
et ad omnem Israël cuncta quæ fuerant sibi imperata.
and to all of Israel, everything that had been commanded to him.
